title: Mycobacterium Phage WST1 isolate:WST1 Genome sequencing and assembly
description: This study presents the complete genome sequence and characterization of Mycobacterium phage WST1, a lytic bacteriophage isolated from wastewater in Chengdu, China. The primary goal is to analyze its genomic features, including gene annotation and phylogenetic relationship within the Siphoviridae family. The phage's potential applications in environmental mycobacterial control and phage therapy are also investigated. Host: Mycobacterium smegmatis mc^2 155.
center: West China School of Public Health and West China Fourth Hospital, Sichuan University
samples: WST1 was isolated from the underground treatment tank of the sewage treatment station of West China Stomatological Hospital.
